about: The V80 compute shell's dynamic region (pblock_slash, SLASH linker/slashkit/resources/base/compute/constraints/impl.xdc) per SLR, its sites counted by Vivado 2025.2 on b4e's opt checkpoint (11-07). Unequal: the static region owns most of SLR0. sites_per_lut converts placed LUTs to foldsim_degree's LUT sites: b4e's largest SLR group, 978,886 estimated sites placed as 672,695 LUTs (post-synth hierarchical utilization), the group that spilled over SLR2/SLR1 at 95 % of SLR2's LUTs. margin: the share of an SLR's LUTs a group may fill and still route at 200 MHz. sll_per_boundary: the V80's super long lines between adjacent SLRs (report_utilization -slr, both boundaries 18,870; Vivado refuses a partition past it: r16c, 11-07, 23,987 needed between SLR1 and SLR2). sll_margin: the share of them the fold's link bits may take (the rest for the shell's crossings and the placer). netlist_lut_scale / netlist_lutram_scale / netlist_ff_scale (foldsim_sll_check.py --resources netlist): synthesized LUTs, LUTRAM and flip-flops per foldsim_cost LUT, memory LUT and flop of a class copy's module, fit 11-07 (est) over 172 copies of 7 synthesized designs (hierarchical utilization: r16c, y8r1di, b4e opt, b4ct150, c2d, pv80, FSD vD) with foldsim_cost packing AND-OR selects and trimming extract-only shifts: one LUT scale 0.782, the designs' copy totals r16c +12.5 %, y8r1di 0, b4e -9.9 %, b4ct150 -7.6 %, c2d -3.8 %, vD +6.6 % (before the packing vD was 0.52 against Vortex's 0.68-0.85); LUTRAM 0.896, flops 0.851. Per copy the residual is larger (b4e core -27 %, vD node model +47 %): foldsim_sll_check.py --synthesis takes a design's own synthesis instead. URAM by ram_style as built: the slice copy 522 counted, 517 synthesized. placed_per_synthesized: placed per synthesized LUT / LUTRAM / flop (b4e's slice copy: 523,144 synthesized and opt, about 524k placed: 1.0; set to make the three placed builds' totals within -4..+4 %). kernel: the kernel beside the simulator (memory endpoints, virtual memory controllers, host interface), not in the netlist: AFU minus simulator level, synthesized, r16c 184k, y8r1di 146k, b4e 140k, c2d 162k, vD 189k LUTs (155k placed); flops b4e 65k. placement: foldsim_sll_check.py's placement model (its own about). 11-11 (a32-G0): netlist_lut_scale 0.782 -> 1.0 with the corrected count (foldsim_fitdb.count / foldsim_cost: the level's array reads, masked LUTRAM, the level logic's synthesized share): the old count was 0.79 of Vivado on the shell-sized profile at 64 SMs (312,396 / 397,700, the 0.782 this scale carried), the corrected one 0.99 (392,397).

placement.about: foldsim_sll_check.py's placement model, fit 11-07 on three placed V80 builds (b4e routed, y8r1di post-place phys_opt, b4ct150 post-place; per-copy SLR placement and SLR-crossing nets read from the checkpoints, est_1107/inv). The placer balances the SLRs: whole copies fill each SLR up to `fill` of a resource (0.70), the region as a whole to `region_fill` (0.80: placed builds 66-74 % of its LUTs, r16c failed at 85 %), a cut copy up to the region fill (logic: LUT, LUTRAM, flops; memories whole counts, their primitives placed apart), the copies other than the cut ones up to the region's fill of the whole design plus balance_slack; where no whole assignment exists the largest copies by logic (at most cut_copies) fill their SLR's room and level the next SLRs' fill. Measured: y8r1di's slice copy 11/62/26 % over SLR2/1/0 (model 14/58/28), SLR fills 60/75/59 % (model 60/75/60); b4e's 8/60/32 % (model 8/66/26). A cut copy's own SLLs follow Rent's rule over its smaller side, rent_t x placed LUTs^rent_p (per-copy fit of the crossing nets: t 0.93-1.52 at p 0.75); links: SLLs per link wire bit between the two sides (measured 0.002-0.065: link memories are read a word at a time); other_slls the simulator level and shell; sll_per_vmem_bit the virtual memory ports' wiring to the kernel's controllers (only y8r1di has many: 23,570 bits). Least squares over the 6 boundaries with links 0.01 and other 500 fixed: worst boundary b4e 9,326 vs 10,114 placed (-8 %), y8r1di 15,015 vs 15,631 (-4 %), b4ct150 9,746 vs 8,981 (+9 %); leave one build out: -10 / -29 / +14 % (the vmem term rests on y8r1di alone). Refit 11-07 19:00 with the synthesis-fit scales and links charged to their readers: worst boundary b4e 9,403 vs 10,134 (-7 %), y8r1di 13,953 vs 15,631 (-11 %), b4ct150 9,436 vs 8,981 (+5 %); modelled slice cuts y8r1di 11 / 62 / 26 % (measured 11 / 62 / 26), b4e 24 / 48 / 28 (8 / 60 / 32), b4ct150 24 / 48 / 28 (13 / 70 / 17); b4ct150's own slice crossing nets 4,150 / 6,447 against Rent 4.7k / 5.7k (not in the fit). sll_per_port_bit (11-08 slrsplit): the links counted by their port widths (each link's bits once, the schedule's "A -> B: n links, m bits"), SLLs per bit where the two ends sit in different SLRs; fit on the split b4e image C-1 (p0 SLR2, p1 SLR1 pblocks; Vivado Place 30-5425 demanded 20,059 SLLs SLR1-SLR2: 11,822 split crossings + 1,002 + 0.45 x 16,057 port bits). At 1 a bit (full width) b4e straddled projects 36k against 4,700 measured; at 0.01 a link bit C-1 projects 13,385 against 20,059. Refit 11-11 (a32-G0): links counted by port width now from the sll estimate's `wires` lines when the schedule has no `A -> B` lines (no --slr-groups: the term had read 0); sll_per_port_bit 0.45 -> 0.39, least squares (other_slls 500 fixed) over the 6 boundaries of y8r1di, b4e, b4ct150 against their measured crossing nets that are neither a copy's own nor a virtual-memory controller's (est_1107/inv/<b>/crossing.tsv: y8r1di 7,209 / 9,943, b4e 2,387 / 2,913, b4ct150 3,585 / 3,792; model 7,325 / 8,163, 4,037 / 4,076, 4,085 / 4,085: -18 to +69 %, the worst b4e SLR2-SLR1 where the model's slice shares 24/48/28 % miss the placed 8/60/32 %). sll_per_vmem_bit is the flat term of --vmem-engines flat only: by default the virtual-memory wiring is placed (the noc section).

noc.about: The compute shell's memory NoC ports, from its NoC solution (flow/v80/noc_ports.py on the b4e image's impl_1/top_wrapper.ncr, 11-09: the pinned shell of 09-01, slash_base.tcl PHYSICAL_LOC NOC_NMU512_X*Y13..17). The RP's NoC master units (NMUs) keep the shell's sites: an RM placing one elsewhere fails opt_design (DRC HDPR-122), and a new NMU to HBM would need a route through the static region's NoC switches. All 8 HBM ports (hbm_vnoc_00..07) enter the NoC in SLR2; SLR1 has 6 DDR4 ports (ddr_noc_4..7, 9, 11: one DDR4-3200 x72 controller, 0x600_0000_0000 32 GB), SLR0 none. read_latency: the NoC compiler's achieved read latency over each NMU's paths (min / mean / max); the 07-31 unpinned shell's hbm_vnoc NMUs in SLR1 read HBM at 69-87 against 25-53 from SLR2. master_bits: an AXI4 master of 512-bit data, 64-bit address and 8-bit IDs (AW and AR 87 each, W 579, R 525, B 12). Placed pricing (foldsim_sll_check.py --vmem-engines, default placer): each controller sits where its wiring crosses the fewest SLLs, between the copies its ports are wired to (their SLR shares) and the nearest HBM NMU over its master; a boundary is charged only the wire bits that cross it: sll_per_port_bit per port bit, sll_per_master_bit per master wire. Fit 11-11 (a32-G0) on y8r1di (s8_1105/img_y8r1di physopt, the one placed build with wide controllers: 8 groups, 23,570 port bits): the placer put every controller beside its copies (slrxing_1108/y8r1di/inst_slr.tsv: g_vg2, VX_opc_unit's, in SLR1, the others with their copies in SLR2), as the model places them; the nets of the controller cells crossing (est_1107/inv/y8r1di/crossing.tsv) are 1,521 over SLR2-SLR1 (VX_opc_unit's master: sll_per_master_bit 1.0) and 290 over SLR1-SLR0 (VX_opc_unit's ports to its copy's 15 % in SLR0: 0.23 a port bit), against the 11-07 flat term's 6,204 at both. b4e and b4ct150 (2 controllers, 2,074 port bits, l2req beside its copy) measure 0 and 1; the model gives 0 and 272 (b4ct150's l2req copy straddles; its port registers sit with the controller).
